instagram_caption:
Jesus, what if You knew what I actually did?

He has been praying around it for months. Close enough to feel guilty, never close enough to say it.

The answer was not a lecture. "It is not bigger than Me. Nothing you have done has made Me want you less."

1 John 1:9 is almost unfair in how simple it is. If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just and will forgive us. Faithful, as in it does not depend on how well you say it.

The thing you are hiding is the thing He is waiting to carry.
